Independent prototype · workforce learning

Lumber Training Portal

A local proof of concept for structured courses, learner progress, assignments, reporting, and controlled media access.

  • RolePrototype design & development
  • TechnologyNext.js · SQLite · media handling
  • StatusLocal stakeholder proof of concept

The problem

Workforce learning needs a clear structure for courses, chapters, sections, assignments, feedback, and progress—plus an experience that works for both the person creating material and the person learning from it.

Approach

I developed a local portal prototype with administrator and learner experiences. Administrators can edit and publish courses, manage learners and assignments, and review reporting. Learners can browse published courses, track progress, complete sections, and provide feedback.

Key decisions

  • Model the learning structure around courses, chapters, and sections.
  • Use SQLite persistence, password hashing, HTTP-only sessions, and authenticated media access.
  • Support local image, video, audio, and PDF uploads for a tangible stakeholder demonstration.
  • Keep training content clearly framed as a demonstration, not approved operating instruction.

What it demonstrates

Translating manufacturing context into a learning product and communicating a workable prototype to stakeholders.

Status

This is a local prototype. A completed public deployment or commercial adoption is not claimed.
